about.title: From Kamojang Crater to D'Glorious Crater
about.historyLead: Kamojang Crater has been known since colonial times as one of the oldest geothermal fields in Indonesia.
about.historyBody: Steam rising from cracks in the rock and the distinct scent of sulfur have long been part of daily life for the surrounding community. For locals, the crater is more than a natural phenomenon — it carries generations of stories about a force of the earth to be respected, and a blessing that warms through its hot springs.
about.historyBody2: Starting as a geothermal conservation area popular among researchers and travelers, we saw the potential to reshape this experience into something more complete. In 2023, D'Glorious Crater Kamojang officially opened — blending geothermal wonders, natural hot springs, and premium glamping in the misty highlands on the Bandung–Garut border, without losing the untamed character that made this place special from the start.
about.historyBody3: Today, D'Glorious Crater Kamojang is home to travelers seeking stillness: steam rising from the crater at dawn, natural hot springs that soothe tired bodies after a long journey, and misty nights under a blanket of stars from inside a glamping tent. Every corner is designed to invite guests to slow down and savor a quiet that's hard to find in the city.
about.historyBody4: We believe well-cared-for nature always has a story to share. That's why our mission is simple yet steadfast: to deliver luxury that lives in harmony with nature, caring for the crater and surrounding forest as seriously as we care for every guest who visits — so this beauty can be enjoyed by generations to come.
